emergency_quests.title: The Sloth Barrier
emergency_quests.trigger: Inactivity detected for over 2 consecutive hours while the app is active.
emergency_quests.objective: Perform 20 glute bridges or a 3-minute max-incline walking pad sprint immediately to break the stagnation buffer.

emergency_quests.title: Hydration Protocol
emergency_quests.trigger: Daily water intake metric falls below target threshold by mid-afternoon.
emergency_quests.objective: Consume 500ml of water immediately.

emergency_quests.title: Posture Correction
emergency_quests.trigger: Accelerometer detects prolonged slouching or hunching over a desk.
emergency_quests.objective: Straighten spine, roll shoulders back, and hold optimal ergonomic posture.

emergency_quests.title: Midnight Breach
emergency_quests.trigger: App remains open and active past midnight on a weekday.
emergency_quests.objective: Lock device, close all applications, and initiate the sleep cycle.

emergency_quests.title: Visual Calibration
emergency_quests.trigger: Screen-on time exceeds 90 continuous minutes without a break.
emergency_quests.objective: Look away from all screens and focus on an object at least 20 feet away.

emergency_quests.title: Sudden Surge
emergency_quests.trigger: Daily step count is falling significantly behind the pacing curve by 6:00 PM.
emergency_quests.objective: Execute a rapid indoor session using the walking pad or march outdoors.

penalty.description: Daily stat growth halved for the day.

emergency_quests.title: Caloric Deficit Alert
emergency_quests.trigger: Logged nutritional intake registers a dangerous drop or skips a primary meal window.
emergency_quests.objective: Consume a high-protein meal or snack to stabilize core energy.

emergency_quests.title: Code Anomaly Detected
emergency_quests.trigger: Extended debugging session with frequent compilation errors or syntax stalls in the IDE.
emergency_quests.objective: Step away from the screen, walk around the room, and reset cognitive focus.

emergency_quests.title: Awakening Stretch
emergency_quests.trigger: First launch of the application in the morning.
emergency_quests.objective: Perform a full-body dynamic stretch routine before interacting with any other apps.

emergency_quests.title: The Distraction Trap
emergency_quests.trigger: Rapid switching away from productive apps or development tools repeatedly.
emergency_quests.objective: Lock focus on a single task without opening social media or secondary tabs.

emergency_quests.title: Core Stabilization
emergency_quests.trigger: Health Connect data shows a drop in weekly active movement averages.
emergency_quests.objective: Hold a strict plank position to reinforce core structural integrity.

emergency_quests.title: Breath of the Hunter
emergency_quests.trigger: Elevated heart rate detected via wearable without a corresponding high-activity log (stress spike).
emergency_quests.objective: Execute 10 slow, deep box-breathing cycles.

emergency_quests.title: Room Clear
emergency_quests.trigger: Workspace environment clutter detected or left untidy for multiple days.
emergency_quests.objective: Completely organize and clear the physical desk/workspace area.

emergency_quests.title: Nightly Fasting Enforcement
emergency_quests.trigger: Attempting to log a late-night snack past the configured fasting window.
emergency_quests.objective: Resist the impulse and consume zero calories until the morning window opens.

emergency_quests.title: Upper Body Activation
emergency_quests.trigger: Upper body workout split day is skipped or delayed past schedule.
emergency_quests.objective: Complete 30 push-ups in maximum of 2 sets.

emergency_quests.title: The 10K Defiance
emergency_quests.trigger: It is 9:00 PM and daily step count is lagging behind the 10,000-step target by more than 3,000 steps.
emergency_quests.objective: Put on shoes and complete a brisk indoor walking pad or outdoor marching session to close the gap.

emergency_quests.title: Iron Will Execution
emergency_quests.trigger: Procrastination alert triggered on a major project task or complex coding problem.
emergency_quests.objective: Write the core implementation or solve the primary blocker immediately without opening other tabs.

emergency_quests.title: Sleep Debt Liquidation
emergency_quests.trigger: Health Connect reports total sleep duration under 5 hours for the previous night.
emergency_quests.objective: Execute an immediate power nap or enforce an early lights-out schedule.

emergency_quests.title: Endurance Crucible
emergency_quests.trigger: Resting heart rate or biometric strain metrics indicate a drop in cardiovascular conditioning.
emergency_quests.objective: Maintain a continuous fast walking pace at maximum incline on the walking pad.

emergency_quests.title: The Hydration Marathon
emergency_quests.trigger: Severe dehydration detected across the first half of the day.
emergency_quests.objective: Consume 1.5 liters of water evenly paced across the afternoon.

emergency_quests.title: Lower Body Awakening
emergency_quests.trigger: Leg day workout missed or postponed twice.
emergency_quests.objective: Complete 50 deep bodyweight lunges or weighted squats.

emergency_quests.title: Digital Quarantine
emergency_quests.trigger: App usage analytics indicate doom-scrolling or excessive non-productive screen time.
emergency_quests.objective: Turn off the phone/screen entirely and place it in another room.

emergency_quests.title: Protein Synthesis Enforcement
emergency_quests.trigger: End-of-day nutritional log reveals a severe protein deficit relative to muscle-building targets.
emergency_quests.objective: Consume a high-protein shake or clean protein source immediately.

emergency_quests.title: The Unyielding Grip
emergency_quests.trigger: Manual trigger during a moment of high mental stress or frustration.
emergency_quests.objective: Hang from a pull-up bar or grip strength trainer until failure (minimum 45 seconds).

emergency_quests.title: Midnight Code Refactor
emergency_quests.trigger: Pushing broken code or messy pull requests late at night.
emergency_quests.objective: Clean, refactor, and document the codebase logic completely.

emergency_quests.title: Monarch's Trial of Blood
emergency_quests.trigger: Biometric data shows 3 consecutive days of zero active workouts or missed fitness goals.
emergency_quests.objective: Complete a full high-intensity workout session without stopping.

emergency_quests.title: The Absolute Silence
emergency_quests.trigger: App detects continuous background noise or audio distraction while deep work/study is scheduled.
emergency_quests.objective: Eliminate all external distractions, silence notifications, and lock into absolute focus.

penalty.description: Zero XP accumulation for the entire day

emergency_quests.title: Abyss Recovery Protocol
emergency_quests.trigger: Health Connect reports less than 4 hours of sleep combined with high stress metrics and missed steps.
emergency_quests.objective: Immediate emergency shutdown: ingest electrolytes, stretch, and enforce an offline sleep schedule.

reward.effect: System Stability Restored, HP Fully Regenerated

emergency_quests.title: The 5K Vanguard Execution
emergency_quests.trigger: System detects long-term plateau in cardiovascular endurance or step consistency.
emergency_quests.objective: Execute an uninterrupted 5-kilometer run or intense sustained cardio session.

penalty.description: Maximum level cap restricted by 1 level until completed

emergency_quests.title: Shadow Sovereign's Mandate
emergency_quests.trigger: Random security audit triggered when user attempts to bypass daily fitness or task quotas.
emergency_quests.objective: Complete all pending daily quests, clear task backlog, and log 10,000 steps before midnight.

reward.effect: Shadow Extraction Slot Unlocked, Massive Stat Surge

penalty.description: Forfeiture of daily gains, base stats dropped to Level 1 for 24 hours.
